Improving Monsters.rtf, hit dice and good saves
printingDistinction: The publisher’s RTF is the authority for Huge size, AC 16, +19 grapple, 15-ft. space and 10-ft. reach, +9 talons (2d8 + 5), the secondary attacks at +4, Hide +5 and Huge advancement. The Large version displayed on d20srd.org follows the separate February 17, 2006 Monster Manual v.3.5 errata for book p. 60.
printedInconsistency: The original RTF and separate Monster Manual erratum both give Fort +10. The generic Animal progression at 8 HD with Con 21 gives +11.
